method: Read-only. Built a one-off Lune scanner (kept outside the repo in the session scratchpad) that loads every source in sources/ with the same loader, path convention ("#n" sibling suffix, loose top-level folders) and Workspace Terrain/Camera skipping as packages/owner-corpus/library_extract.luau, so every reported path resolves with `library_extract.luau extract <file> <path> self <out.rbxm>`.

Per file: nearest Model/Tool/Accessory ancestor of every Motor6D/Bone/Humanoid/AnimationController (chains merged when the parent holds a single rig and modest parts), joint names and Part0>Part1 pairs, part/MeshPart counts, MeshId/TextureId presence, AABB of descendant parts, Animation ids; plus name-token matching (camelCase split) for 60 fruit/vegetable words.

Systems/UI come from knowledge/<game>.json cards, knowledge/genres/plants-vs-brainrots.json, ui.json (367 kits, 18979 screens), assets.json, and from reading the actual script sources (contracts verified by regex over decompiled source for WaitForChild/workspace paths/tags/attributes/remotes/DataStore names).
notVerified: No network/Studio: mesh and texture asset loadability, whether bone-rigged MeshParts carry real skin weights, and Bone.Transform server->client replication are NOT verified.
Sizes are the AABB of the saved pose, not a rest pose; some assets are saved scaled.
Creature-like classification is keyword + structure heuristics; counts are for planning, not exact.

b_bone.definition: Bone instances (skeleton; the MeshPart(s) are skinned to it). Non-humanoid creatures only unless stated
b_bone.typicalLayout: One invisible/anchored "Root" (or "HumanoidRootPart"/Hitbox) Part carrying a Bone chain (CupMaster > Bone > Arm.L/Arm.R/Leg.L/Leg.R ...), 1..N MeshParts each attached to Root by a Motor6D named "<MeshName>Motor6D" (Studio 3D-importer rig layout); or a single MeshPart with Bone children (Blender/Mixamo skinned mesh). Bone naming is Blender style (Bone, Bone.001, Arm.L.001, Leg.R.002) or Mixamo (Hips, LeftArm, LeftUpLeg).
b_bone.skinningCaveat: Whether a MeshPart is truly skinned is stored inside the uploaded mesh asset (weights), not in the place file. Bone-rigged bodies therefore keep the original mesh; fruit meshes can only be attached rigidly (Motor6D/Weld to a rigid body part), not re-skinned.

creatureAnimations.verdict: Creature/plant/brainrot Animation instances are rbxassetid uploads from the original creators (1186 of 1207 distinct ids are >= 1e10, i.e. 2023+ uploads); none are from the Roblox default pack. They are the ones that fail to load for a different account: procedural animation is mandatory.

animations.whereTheyLive: Usually NOT inside the rig: (a) ReplicatedStorage/Assets/Animations/<Brainrots|Plants>/<Name>/{Walk,Idle,Attack} (PVB core), (b) <Model>/Animations/Walk (PVB variants, loaded client-side by EnemyClient/PlantClient), (c) ReplicatedStorage/Animations/Animals/<Name>/Idle|Walk. 428 of 2575 non-humanoid creature rigs carry an Animation instance inside the model itself.
animations.jointAnimationNote: Animation clips drive Motor6D.Transform (rigid) or Bone.Transform (skinned). Both are plain writable properties, so a script can pose a rig each frame (RunService.Heartbeat) without any Animation asset. Client-side writes are the normal route; server-side Bone/Motor6D Transform replication should be verified once in Studio.

workspace: Workspace.Map.PlotLocations (one slot per plot; attributes PlotIndex, Occupied)

Plot model children read by name: Lanes.Lanes.Lane1..7 (Waypoints Enter/Exit attachments, X must match placement within +-3 studs), Lanes.LanesButtons, Lanes.LawnMowerLocations, Plants (Folder), Enemies (Folder), EnemySpawn.Waypoints, OwnerBillboard.BillboardGui{NameLabel,ImageLabel}, OwnerSpawnPoint (Attachment), Platforms.Platforms.PlatformN, Platforms.Placement, Monetization, container
replicatedStorage: Assets/Enemies (65 rigged enemy models: 26 Motor6D, 39 Bone), Assets/Plants (10 lean rigged fruit/veg turrets), Assets/Extra/{EnemyOverhead,CostUI}
remotes: Networker channels "PlantService" (place), "EnemySpawn", "SeedShop", "Sell" (created by Networker, no RemoteEvent instances to pre-create)
attributes: plant/plantNumber/multiplier/mutation/timePlaced/damage on tools and plant models; laneNumber, playerName
dataStoreKeys: ProfileStore via PlayerDataModule; "GameProgressDataStore" in GameDataStore script

api: PlantService:place(player, plantName, position, laneNumber, tool?) server-validated (lane unlocked, X inside lane, inventory, MaxPlantsPlacedPerLane*LanesUnlocked)
Plot.GetFromOwner(player), Plot._attackEnemiesInLane(lane) (each plant hits enemies[1] every PlantAttackSpeed, 0.2 s delay)
Plant class: damage = data.damage*size*mutation multiplier; plant grows over data.timeToGrow (timePlaced attribute, growingPart tag) - growth is visual time-to-ready, not a crop cycle
gives.data: Data/Plants {timeToGrow, damage, rarity, price, stockChance, maxStockAmount, seedColor}

plot_planting_growth.notes: Small (100 non-package scripts) class/service architecture, the cleanest plot+placement code in the library. Needs a map template with the exact plot children above; everything else is data modules + 6 shared packages. Notes: no separate crop-growth cycle (plants are turrets). Needs animations slot Animations.Attack/Walk on models (creator-owned ids) -> replace with procedural.
plot_planting_growth.verdict: BEST base for a lane defense placement loop; port the Plot template names, drop Robux/Products.

blockersAndRisks.item: Skinned Bone rigs dominate creature rigs
blockersAndRisks.detail: Among non-humanoid creature rigs, 1830 of 2575 records (71%) and 6122 of 7471 instances (82%) are Bone rigs, concentrated in 20 games (brainrot/animal games). 472 have Bones inside a MeshPart and ~all have 1..N MeshParts attached to a Root part. Fruit meshes cannot be re-skinned onto them: either keep their original mesh or attach fruit as rigid children. Motor6D bodies exist (617 non-humanoid records in 33 games, 1835 Humanoid R6/R15 records in 193 games) and are the route for "rig + fruit meshes". This is a constraint, not a blocker.
1186 of 1207 distinct creature Animation ids are >= 1e10 rbxassetid uploads; none belong to the Roblox default pack. Plan on 100% procedural Motor6D/Bone animation (confirmed design).

blockersAndRisks.item: Most Motor6D creature joint names are generic
blockersAndRisks.detail: 422 of 617 non-humanoid Motor6D creatures use Part###/MeshPart### names (Blender/Studio import); only 104 use stock R6/R15 names and 91 semantic names. Procedural animation must derive limbs from hierarchy/position, or start from the stock R6/R15/semantic bodies recommended.

Fruit and creature meshes are rbxassetid references (no bytes in the library for these). Several best clean fruit/veg sources (grow_a_garden Fruit_Spawn) are built from primitive Parts/Unions with NO MeshId, which is self-contained but not "real mesh". Loadability of referenced mesh ids is unverified.

blockersAndRisks.item: No system has a real wave counter
blockersAndRisks.detail: Enemy spawners are continuous (PvB) or legacy globals (Guest Defense); we must write WaveService (index, composition tables, leak/lose rule, counter UI). UI kits supply only countdown-shaped elements.

PvB core needs Plots 1..6 tree + 186 remotes + ~10 hard-required sibling modules; grow_a_garden needs Workspace.Farm + ServerStorage.PlayerData; only Easy Plot System and the Persistence wrapper are truly standalone. The modded PvB variant is the best semi-standalone donor (needs Map/Plots/PlotTemplate).
